articles.title: Netomi CEO says $5 trillion AI customer experience market could boost stablecoin demand
articles.snippet: Puneet Mehta, a former high-level Wall Street engineer and data scientist, said the rapid expansion of AI enterprise software will increase demand for stablecoins and blockchain.

articles.title: Japan's three largest banks aim for joint stablecoin issue by March
articles.snippet: MUFG, SMBC and Mizuho will establish a council to explore operational frameworks and prepare for the issuance of stablecoins.

articles.title: Anchorage backs Treasury’s GENIUS AML rules, seeks secondary-market sanctions clarity
articles.snippet: A public comment letter argues that regulated stablecoin issuers need clearer compliance standards to avoid sanctions risks tied to secondary-market activity.

articles.title: Onchain gambling keeps rolling with $14B quarter despite crypto slump: TRM Labs
articles.snippet: TRM Labs said onchain gambling reached $51 billion in 2025, with repeat users and stablecoin flows helping the sector remain resilient during a broader crypto market pullback.

articles.title: Hyperliquid, Paradigm urge revision of GENIUS money-laundering rule
articles.snippet: The Hyperliquid Policy Center and Paradigm say the Treasury’s money-laundering rules for the GENIUS Act are too onerous for stablecoin issuers.
